# v0.5.0

## Annotated Tag Message

Read-only local setup guidance, hardware-based model recommendation, and explicit
onboarding actions.

## GitHub Release Body

`v0.5.0` adds `cowork setup` for local onboarding. Setup is read-only by
default: it inspects hardware and installed Ollama models, recommends a model,
and reports planned actions as deterministic JSON. Exact installed-model names
control whether a pull is needed. `--pull` permits pulling a missing chosen
model, while `--write-config` permits writing ask config to the default user
target or an explicit project target. Replacing changed ask values requires
`--force`. Setup probes only a chosen model that was already installed or was
successfully pulled. `cowork doctor` now reports installed-model state and
skips its probe when the effective model is missing.

## Highlights

- `cowork setup` is read-only by default and returns deterministic JSON on
  stdout
- hardware facts drive a built-in recommended model selection
- installed models match by exact Ollama model name
- `--pull` and `--write-config` explicitly enable setup mutations
- config writes default to user config, with project config as an explicit
  target
- changed ask model or host values require `--force`
- setup probes only an installed or successfully pulled chosen model
- doctor reports installed-model state and skips its probe when the effective
  model is missing

## Notes

- source-only release, with no crates.io package or prebuilt binaries
- setup never installs Ollama
- Windows is unsupported and untested in v0.5.0
- release behavior shipped in PRs `#44` through `#61`
